commands: npm run check && npm run build (editors)

vsix.distribution: Core source included; installed Julia and dependency depot still required

footprint.meaning: Line count measures source size; it does not establish feature completeness or agent quality.

negative_results_and_fixes: Actual HTTP response status is Int16; status classification now accepts Integer.
RPC rejects foreign conversation source access using ShenScopeError, not a framing RPCFault; the ownership expectation was corrected.
Cold JIT exceeded a subsecond fixture wall budget. The I/O deadline fixture warms the identical request path; no hard CPU/JIT preemption is claimed.
Native GUI initially used its own state directory and could not find the seeded conversation. Native launcher statePath is now configurable.
Selecting Context while sessions/get was pending returned the UI to Chat. History callbacks now preserve newer navigation and selected-session ownership.
Consecutive instruction approvals shared an action label. Tests now track distinct permission request IDs.

Legacy protocol and editor tests awaited completion before responding to the new optional archive persistence request. They now explicitly approve or deny archive persistence and verify scoped ownership.

The 120-second editor test wrapper could expire while a 120-second initialize request ran alongside CPU-heavy checks. The wrapper now has 240 seconds, RPC deadlines remain unchanged, milestones are recorded, and the final actual flow took 60.84 seconds.
limits: Token counts are byte/Unicode estimates, not exact provider tokenizers.
Source citations verify message identity, not the semantic correctness of model summaries; no live-model quality result.
No recursive instruction discovery, conditional rule globs or watcher.
No multimedia slimming, automatic model summaries or pre/post-compaction Hooks.
Original session journals remain unbounded by this checkpoint; large-history indexing and artifact/checkpoint garbage collection remain unfinished.
HTTP I/O deadlines and Julia cancellation are soft budgets, not OS isolation or forced JIT/CPU preemption.
Process events decode fragmented UTF-8; PTY and native terminal integration remain pending.
Development Workbench is not a completed desktop installer; Windows packaging remains unfinished.
Cloud onboarding configuration is saved as a draft, not published/applied or restoration-verified.
The 250000 authored Core LOC and full functional gates are not reached; development continues.
